case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Authorised AI assessment contributions, accountable human group responsibility and protection of group personal information.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: No Murdoch policy governs admitting a persistent AI agent into a student group workspace, assigning accountable human group responsibility for its identifiable contributions, or protecting group personal information retained across sessions.
case_summary.case_note: Murdoch's Student Academic Integrity Policy (N087, 6.3.1) prohibits submitting AI-produced work without specific assessment authorisation, and Digital and Technology Conditions of Use (N077, 1.12) require reasonable safeguards for personally identifiable information. However, Murdoch policies do not regulate persistent AI agents participating in shared group workspaces, leaving human group accountability and cross-session group data protection as a critical gap. Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15, and this proposal awaits human verification.
